notes: Teacher output is pseudo-label, never ground truth. 'zebra' boxes may cover only white stripes; traffic-light colour is decided by separate downstream logic. class_filters.zebra was tuned on 421 Roboflow train images and checked on 421 others against human zebra labels: precision 0.35->0.57, recall 0.54->0.47, F1 0.43->0.51 (IoU>=0.5). Still weak; prefer the fine-tuned detector for zebra.
